- 10:00–10:40: Systems & scale deep-dive (Marcus Lin)
- 11:00–11:40: Distributed design + tradeoffs (Maya Srinivasan)
- 12:00–12:40: Coding pair (remote) (Evaluator: TBD)
- 01:00–01:25: Product fit + wrap (Kimberly Park)

Notes: 20 minute breaks between 1&2 and 2&3 to allow short internal syncs and candidate bio recovery. I attached a strawman agenda (full_loop_agenda_v1.pdf) with question themes and debrief prompts. If Marcus or Kimberly prefer different ordering, please flag — otherwise we'll lock this and Kimberly can send invites.

Jordan — is the 10am start on Tue 8/22 workable? If not, share an alternate window. Also flag any accessibility needs.

Best,
